v2.3 quality enhancement - security audit + marketing packaging + slug-content validation

Initial release with ARCH-5: PG authoritative, SQLite cache, no Saga dual-write.

- PostgreSQL as the single source of truth for all checkpoints, with resilient crash recovery.
- SQLite serves as a lossy, fast local cache (fire-and-forget, WAL mode, TTL 300s) for high qps reads.
- Removed Saga/event-sourcing dual-write. Consistency relies solely on PG.
- Eight workflow tools offered: save_checkpoint, get_checkpoint, get_cached_state, list_checkpoints, cache_to_sqlite, rebuild_sqlite_cache, verify_checkpoint_integrity, and healthcheck.
- Supports explicit cache rebuilding, tenant isolation, integrity verification, health checks, and detailed error handling
